specs.Supported Application: Alarm, Fitness Tracker, Heart Rate Monitor, Messages, Pedometer, Reminders, Sleep Monitor
specs.Metrics Measured: Blood Pressure, Calories Burned, Heart Rate, Sleep Duration, Step Count

features: 【Real-Time Heart Rate & BP Tracking】Stay in tune with your health every day! The Smart Fitband provides real-time monitoring of heart rate and blood pressure, so you can track fitness levels during workouts, daily walks, or rest. Accurate sensors let you see trends and make smarter lifestyle choices to improve endurance, manage stress, and support a healthy heart effortlessly.

【Instant Message & Call Alerts】Never miss important updates with vibrating notifications straight to your wrist! Smart alerts from calls, SMS, WhatsApp, and social apps keep you connected wherever you are—at work, the gym, or on a run. No need to check your phone constantly; stay focused on your day while your Fitband silently keeps you in the loop.

【Activity & Step Tracking】Embrace an active lifestyle! Track daily steps, calories burned, and distance walked to set, measure, and achieve your personal fitness goals. Whether you’re running, training, or just walking around the office, real-time data motivates you to move more and build healthier habits effortlessly every single day.

【Sleep Analysis & Recovery】Gain insight into your nightly rest! The Fitband monitors light, deep, and awake sleep stages, helping you understand your sleep quality. Use detailed data to improve bedtime routines, recover better from workouts, and wake up refreshed, focused, and energized to take on daily challenges with a clear mind.

【Long Battery & Bluetooth Sync】Enjoy seamless Bluetooth pairing and impressive battery life! Sync fitness data easily to your smartphone and keep track of progress over time. The long-lasting battery keeps you powered for multiple days on a single charge—no daily charging stress—perfect for busy routines, travel, and workouts.
